story.originalTitle: Edd Straw's 2026 Italian Grand Prix F1 driver rankings
story.summaryEn: Edd Straw has ranked the driver performances at the 2026 F1 Italian Grand Prix, a race that delivered a memorable home win alongside a bad stumble from the home team.
detailZh: 意大利大奖赛带来了大量精彩场面，以及一场特别令人难忘的主场胜利——不过当地车迷也不得不面对主队严重失误的局面。
这两件事正好对应了本周车手排行榜的两个极端，那么其他车手的表现又如何呢？
冠军级会员还可以尝试自己排出车手排行榜，让埃德在另一篇专题中作出回应！
——他在第二节排位赛的单圈成绩以及第三节排位赛中不按常规、不借助前车牵引的单圈表现暗示，尽管整个周末并未专注于单圈速度，他其实具备争夺杆位的节奏。
- 无论是比赛开始的两圈（总共提升了七个名次），还是在超越其他赛车以追上拉塞尔时的果断表现，都是他能够取得这场意外胜利的关键。
- 他完全没有表现出任何受到压力的迹象，无论是争冠形势的压力，还是在蒙扎比赛的压力——他在2024年和2025年都曾在这里经历过艰难时刻。
- 有一些情况对他有利，尽管他仍然需要非常出色地驾驶才能充分利用这些有利因素。
- 在比赛后期进攻拉塞尔时，他被破碎的赛道表面打了个措手不及，在缠斗中出现失误，导致他冲出赛道驶过砂石缓冲区，这本可能造成更严重的后果，不过他恢复得很好。
结论：由于他的任务本身难度很大，那次压到砂石的时刻并没有让他失去榜首的位置。
- 他的排位赛执行几乎无可挑剔，随着排位赛进行逐渐找到节奏，合理地为自己寻找尾流，并在至关重要的杆位单圈上做出了他最好的三个计时段。
- 正赛中的驾驶很聪明，他意识到阿尔派的正赛节奏意味着他不可避免地会被大车队的赛车超越。尽管如此，他还是在前段时间挡住了诺里斯，所以他做到了力所能及的一切。
- 实事求是地说，以第七名成为中游车队的领头羊，已经是最佳的正赛结果了。
- 没有什么真正值得注意的地方——而在正赛里这反而是令人印象深刻的，因为他的队友用行动展示了在阿尔频（阿尔派）里过于激进会发生什么。
结论：用一场聪明的正赛印证了他出色的排位表现。
- 比赛过程很聪明，特别是在比赛尾声守住领先位置时，成功迫使安东内利犯错。
- 很好地应对了比赛后段前轮的振动问题，将损失的时间降到最低。
虚拟安全车（VSC）出动的时机很不幸，让安东内利得以低成本进站，从而改变了前方争夺战的走向。
本应拿到杆位，但刹车锁死的问题以及在最后一场第三节排位赛（Q3）飞驰圈时离维斯塔潘太近，这些因素叠加导致他滑落到加斯利身后。
看上去缺少安东内利那种极限速度，不过由于两人在排位赛和正赛策略上的处理方式不同，直接比较并不容易。
结论：比外界说他“搞砸了”的论调要好，但尚未达到安东内利的水平。
- 在排位赛中取得了他所谓的“小型胜利”，成功进入第二节排位赛（Q2），并以0.001秒的优势击败了奥康，排位成绩已无提升空间。
- 充分利用了低成本的虚拟安全车进站时机，最终以第13名完赛，抓住了这个机会，取得了比威廉姆斯赛车本应达到的更好成绩。
- 尽管发车时起步不错，但在第一圈结束时还是被挤到了后面——不过只是落后于更快的赛车。
结论：在之前两站比赛中出现重大失误后，这场比赛恢复了将赛车性能发挥到极致的状态。
- 有时展现出令人印象深刻的速度，并且在大部分时间里看起来对赛车的掌控非常到位。
- 考虑到他的速度始终不足以威胁加斯利，第八名可能已经是他能取得的最好成绩。
- 尽管在老化较严重的硬胎上的挣扎似乎比加斯利更多一些，但还是跑出了一场干净利落的好比赛。
- 排位赛第三节令人失望，他在无线电中为浪费了时间而道歉——不过他表示那损失大概只有十分之一秒左右。
在硬胎的长距离阶段（阶段）中，他的节奏管理可能大部分时间过于保守，但那是车队下达的指令所致，所以确实不能算在他头上。
结论：除了又一次在第三节排位赛（Q3）表现欠佳之外，这是一个不错的周末。
在大奖赛中获得第三名，已经是最好的结果了。
尽管红牛赛车速度不够快，他还是尽可能地咬住了领先集团的争夺，考虑到能量部署方面对梅赛德斯的劣势，这并不容易。
- 当赛车状态正常时，他通常能完全发挥出赛车的全部速度——即使排位赛中出现影响后部离地高度的问题，他也尽力做到了最好。
- 考虑到他因缺席第一次自由练习而处于被动局面，这是一个完成得不错的周末。
- 主要的负面因素是两次在第一个减速弯冲出赛道：一次是在他最后一节第三节排位赛（Q3）飞驰圈开始时，导致他失去了跟在迈凯伦后面的尾流优势，另一次发生在正赛期间。
结论：他已从红牛这套赛车包里榨取了一切可能的速度。
- 在缠斗中驾驶得非常聪明，最后一圈在与皮亚斯特里争夺第四名的较量中战术运用更胜一筹，最终胜出。
虽然排位赛成绩令人失望，但这需要打个星号，因为皮亚斯特里在第一个减速弯的失误使他失去了尾流（tow）的帮助。
在执行排位赛单圈时表现不够稳定，这也导致他只能从发车位的第八位起步。
结论：尽管排位赛令人失望，他仍是迈凯伦车手中表现略胜一筹的那一位。
detailEn: The Italian Grand Prix delivered a lot of action and a particularly memorable home win - though the local crowds also had to contend with the home team tripping up badly.
Those two things cover off the two opposite ends of our driver rankings this week, but what about the rest of the field?
Champions-tier members can also try their hand at putting their own driver rankings together for Edd to react to in a separate feature!
- Hinted with his Q2 lap and his out-of-sequence no-tow Q3 lap that he had the pace for pole despite not focusing on single-lap pace through the weekend.
- Incisiveness both on the two opening laps (gaining a total of seven places), then in clearing cars to get to Russell, was key to pulling off his unexpected win.
- Showed no sign of the pressure of either the championship situation or being at Monza, where he'd had tough times both in 2024 and 2025, getting to him.
- There were circumstances that played in his favour, even though he still had to drive superbly to capitalise on them.

- The error in battle when he was caught out by the breaking-up track surface while attacking Russell late on led to a trip through the gravel that could have been more costly, although he recovered well.
Verdict: The difficulty of his mission means the gravel moment doesn't cost him top spot.

- His execution of qualifying was close to flawless, finding pace as the session progressed, positioning himself well for tows and putting together his best three sectors on the all-important pole lap.

- Drove intelligently in the race, realising that the race pace of the Alpine was such that he was inevitably going to fall behind the big-team cars. That said, he covered Norris for some time, so he did what he could.
- Realistically, top of the midfield in seventh place was the optimum race result.
- Nothing of any real note - and in the race that's impressive given his team-mate showed what could go wrong if you got overambitious in an Alpine.
Verdict: Backed up his brilliant qualifying with an intelligent race.
- Raced intelligently, particularly in the way he forced Antonelli into an error when attempting to hang onto the lead late on.
- Dealt well with the front tyre vibration in the closing stages to minimise the time loss.
- The VSC timing was unfortunate, allowing Antonelli to make a cheap stop and transforming the trajectory of the battle at the front.
- Should have taken pole position, but a combination of struggling with brake locking and being too close to Max Verstappen on his final Q3 lap contributed to him slipping behind Gasly.
- Appeared to lack Antonelli's edge of pace, although direct comparisons are difficult because of the different approaches to qualifying and race strategy.
Verdict: Better than the narrative that he 'flopped' suggests, but not at Antonelli's level.
- Produced what he called "mini wins" in qualifying by reaching Q2 and beating Esteban Ocon, by 0.001s, and couldn't have qualified higher.
- Made the most of the cheap virtual safety car pitstop to come through to 13th, making the most of that opportunity to finish higher than a Williams should have done.
- Despite getting a good launch at the start, he was shuffled back by the end of the lap - albeit only behind quicker cars.
Verdict: After big errors in the last two events, was back on car-maximising form.
- At times, showed impressive pace and appeared to be on top of the car for the most part.
- Eighth was probably the best he could achieve given he never showed the speed to threaten Gasly.
- Drove a good, clean race despite seeming to struggle a little more with ageing hards than Gasly.
- Q3 was a disappointment, and he apologised over the radio for leaving time on the table - albeit he suggested that was only in the vicinity of a tenth.
- Perhaps over-managed for much of the hard stint, but that was down to instructions from the team so doesn't really count against him.
Verdict: Another Q3 underperformance aside, a good weekend.
- Third place in the grand prix was the best possible result.
- Hung around the lead battle while he could despite the Red Bull not being as quick, which was not easy given the deployment disadvantage to Mercedes.
- When the car was working as it should, he generally extracted all of the pace from it - and even when there was a problem in qualifying that compromised the rear ride height he made the best of it.
- Considering he was on the back foot after missing FP1, it was a well-worked weekend.
- Two offs at the first chicane, one at the start of his final Q3 run that meant he lost the tow to the McLarens and another during the race, the main negatives.
Verdict: Got everything he could out of the Red Bull package.
- Drove intelligently in battle, exemplified by out-deploying Piastri to prevail in their battle for fourth on the last lap.
- While the qualifying result was disappointing, there's an asterisk against it in that Piastri's first-chicane error cost him a tow.
- Wasn't consistent in executing qualifying laps, which contributed to being only eighth on the grid.
Verdict: Marginally the more accomplished McLaren driver despite qualifying disappointment.
keyPointsZh: 排名中特别提到一位车手在Q2的计时圈以及Q3不按常规、不做牵引的飞圈中展现出足以争夺杆位的速度，尽管他整个周末并未专注于单圈速度。
冠军级会员可以尝试自己制作车手排名，供Edd在另一篇专题中回应。
keyPointsEn: The rankings highlight a driver whose Q2 lap and out-of-sequence no-tow Q3 lap hinted he had the pace for pole despite not focusing on single-lap pace through the weekend.
Champions-tier members can also try making their own driver rankings for Edd to react to in a separate feature.

relatedItems.titleZh: 博塔斯解释巴库站大幅落后佩雷兹的原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 博塔斯透露，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上他平均每圈比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒，是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距，他对此表示在直道和弯角都无法跟上节奏。
relatedItems.originalTitle: The slowest race of F1 2026 explained
relatedItems.summaryEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed why he was on average more than 1.7 seconds per lap slower than his Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race-day intra-team deficit of the 2026 season so far.
detailZh: 瓦尔特里·博塔斯透露了上一站巴库比赛中，他相比凯迪拉克F1队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹速度严重不足的一些原因。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，博塔斯平均每圈比佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒之多，这是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距。甚至他的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒。
博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙，因为他在驶过1号弯逃生通道后，赛车的能量输出模式“有点混乱”，而由于多跑了距离，他在进入15号弯左弯时后刹车失效，车头撞上了护墙。
但更令人担忧的是此前惊人的速度差距，在博塔斯撞车之前，佩雷兹几乎已经套了他一圈。
“我理解从外面看起来情况很糟糕，坐在车里感觉也很糟糕，”博塔斯周四在马来西亚说。
“当时根本没办法跟上大部队。我在比赛中尝试了所有办法，也得到了很多关于我在哪里损失时间的反馈。很大一部分是在直道上，但也有相当大的一部分是在整圈的弯道中损失掉的。
“所以我一直在坚持推进直到最后，这也是为什么我在最后一圈进一号弯时锁死了轮胎。
“不过是的，关键问题是在练习中我们就已经看到我的速度不够。我无法像佩雷兹那样以同样的速度过弯，所以我们在排位赛前做了很多改动，包括一些减震器和底板，结果感觉确实好多了。
“但在正赛中，行驶品质又明显衰减了很多……我们这次改动了很多东西，所以我觉得问题在于减震器随温度衰减，还有底板……我们在某些地方仍然缺少一些压力测量点，所以对于气动部件，我还拿不到过去习惯获得的完整信息。
“通过数据你马上就能看出性能是提升还是下降，但现在底板有一些区域我们完全看不见。不过就我个人的感觉而言，更多问题出在行驶品质上——再加上动力转向整个周末都在不断衰减。所以我在整场比赛中真的很难去感受赛车。
“这些因素叠加在一起。而且动力单元的差距可能比我们预想的要大，至少从数据上看是这样。
“理论上我们有一个数字，但那是新引擎对全新引擎，也就是新规格对旧规格的对比。所以，我想就是这些因素叠加的结果。我当时确实相当慢。”
动力单元方面的差异指的是佩雷兹在巴库已经用上了升级版 ADUO 2 法拉利引擎，而博塔斯还没有。
此前这被描述为“细微差别”，但正如博塔斯所说，这次升级的效果可能比最初想象的更大。
博塔斯表示，他的 ADUO 2 引擎能否及时送到、让他能在雪邦赛道使用，可能性是“五五开”；如果赶不上，他就得等到下周的新加坡大奖赛。
他的队友佩雷兹本周末不会使用这套引擎，而是换用自己引擎池中的另一套动力单元，以便把升级版留到更能发挥作用的比赛周末再使用。
佩雷斯解释说：“我们做出了一个我们认为胜算最大的决定。”
“这就是为什么我们会在这里承受一些损失。但我们希望这会有所回报。”
“我们对这个周末并不太乐观。所以我们决定把它省下来。”
正如佩雷斯所暗示的，凯迪拉克的车手们已经为艰难的周末做好了准备，因为雪邦赛道带来了两个凯迪拉克尤其难以应对的挑战：轮胎过热和高速弯角。
正如佩雷兹所解释的，凯迪拉克目前“赛车的下压力严重不足，而且阻力很大”。
“在巴库，我基本上整场比赛都保持在超车模式上，所以才能跟住其他车手，”佩雷兹说。
“但当我超过他们之后，我就只能像个乘客一样，因为我没有直道速度。所以我们有两大问题：下压力不足和很大的阻力。”
“但我们一直都知道，第一年会很艰难。”
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed some of the reasons behind his woeful lack of pace compared to Cadillac Formula 1 team-mate Sergio Perez last time out in Baku.

Bottas was on average over a whopping 1.7 seconds slower than Perez per lap at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race day intra-team deficit of 2026 so far. Even his single fastest lap was 1.489s slower than Perez.

Bottas ended up in the wall on the final lap as his car’s deployment pattern “got a bit confused” because he went down the Turn 1 escape road, then because of the extra distance travelled his rear brakes didn’t work going into the Turn 15 left-hander, where he nosed into the barriers.
But what was more worrying was the alarming lack of pace before then, with Perez close to lapping Bottas before the latter's crash.
“I understand it looked pretty bad from the outside and felt pretty bad in the car as well,” Bottas said on Thursday in Malaysia.

“There was just no way to keep up with the pack. I tried everything during the race, and got lots of feedback on where I am losing the time. A lot of it was on the straights, but also a big chunk was just all around the lap in the corners.
“That's why I just kept pushing until the end and that's why I had to lock up on the last lap into Turn 1.

“But yeah, the main thing was we saw already in practice that I was lacking pace. I couldn't carry the same speed through the corners as Checo, so we changed a lot for the qualifying, including some dampers and the floor, and it actually felt a lot better.

“But then the ride again during the race degraded quite a lot... Again, we've changed a lot of things, so I think it's something to do with dampers degging with heat, the floor... We are still lacking a bit of pressure tappings here and there, so we still don't have the full information on aero parts that I'm used to from the past.

“You can immediately see if you're down or up, but now there are some bits of the floor where we are blind. But for me, feeling-wise, it was more the ride - that, in combination with the power steering that was degging throughout the weekend. So I was really then also struggling to feel the car throughout the race.
“So those things combined. And then the [power unit] difference was probably bigger than we thought, at least from the data.
“We've got a number in theory, but that's new engine versus new one, of the new and old spec. So yeah, I think those combined. I was pretty slow.”
The power unit difference is in reference to Perez having the upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine in Baku while Bottas doesn’t yet have it.
This was previously described as a “small difference”, but as Bottas says the upgrade may be more powerful than first thought.
Bottas says it’s “50/50” if his ADUO 2 engine arrives in time for him to run it at Sepang; if not, he’ll have to wait until next week in Singapore.
Team-mate Perez won’t be running it this weekend, swapping to a different power unit in his pool in order to save it for a weekend when it will be more beneficial.
“We took a decision where we feel we got the best shot at it,” Perez explained.
“That's why we're taking a bit of a hit here. But we hope that it will pay us back.
“We are not too optimistic about this weekend. So we decided to save it.”
As Perez alluded, the Cadillac drivers are braced for a difficult weekend because Sepang poses two challenges the Cadillac struggles with in particular: tyre overheating and high-speed corners.
As Perez explains, the Cadillac has “a massive lack of load in the car and a lot of drag” right now.
“In Baku, I basically stayed on the overtake mode for the entire race and therefore I was able to stay with the others,” Perez said.
“But when I overtook them, I was just a passenger because I had no straightline speed. So we have two big issues: load and a lot of drag.
“But we always knew this first year was going to be tricky.”
keyPointsZh: 博塔斯的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒
他因驶入1号弯逃生通道导致能量输出模式混乱，15号弯后刹车失灵撞上护墙
佩雷兹在博塔斯撞车前几乎已经套圈
keyPointsEn: Bottas's fastest single lap was still 1.489s slower than Perez's
His car's deployment pattern got confused after he took the Turn 1 escape road, leaving his rear brakes without effect at Turn 15 where he nosed into the barriers
Perez was close to lapping Bottas before the Finn's crash on the final lap

relatedItems.titleZh: 奥孔与哈斯关系破裂的多重原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 埃斯特班·奥孔离开哈斯车队时再度提及“超出自己控制的因素”，暗示这段车手与车队关系的逐渐恶化。哈斯早在夏休期后便通知奥孔大概率不会留队，而法拉利支持的青训车手拉法·卡马拉被认为是接替他的热门人选。
relatedItems.originalTitle: All the reasons the Ocon-Haas relationship fell apart
relatedItems.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon marked his exit from Haas with another reference to elements beyond his control, hinting at a gradual deterioration of the driver-team relationship. Haas decided long ago not to activate its contractual option and informed Ocon shortly after the summer break that he was unlikely to be retained.
keyPointsZh: 哈斯拥有下赛季保留奥孔的合同选择权，但早已决定不激活，并在夏休期后不久通知了他。
法拉利支持的拉法·卡马拉是最热门的接替人选，有人推测是法拉利对其青训车手的支持将奥孔挤出车门。
签约时奥孔是哈斯自2016年车队成立赛季引进罗曼·格罗斯让以来拥有的最成功车手。
keyPointsEn: Haas had a contractual option to retain Ocon for next year, decided long ago not to activate it, and notified him shortly after the summer break.
Ferrari-backed Rafa Camara is the favourite to replace Ocon, leading some to infer Ferrari's support of its junior driver is pushing Ocon out.
When signed, Ocon was the most successful driver Haas had employed since Romain Grosjean, a 10-time podium finisher who joined for the team's inaugural 2016 season.
